data.eyebrow: Mineral Point, WI · A Driftless dinner house
data.title: The kitchen is closer to your plate than the highway
data.subtitle: Ridge & Field is a 28-seat dinner house built around three Driftless farms, a wood hearth, and a cellar of small-production upper-Midwest wines. Five courses, two seatings, Tuesday through Saturday.

data.title: Chef Anika Rasmussen runs a four-person line — and answers her own phone
data.subtitle: Ridge & Field opened in 2022 in a 1903 stone building on Mineral Point's High Street. Anika came home to the Driftless after fifteen years on lines in San Francisco, Copenhagen, and the upper peninsula.

data.heading: The week's menu
data.intro: Menus turn weekly. Pairings are drawn from our cellar of small-production upper-Midwest producers.

items.title: Garden
items.description: Late-summer tomatoes with smoked ricotta + marigold honey. Eat with your hands.

items.title: From the river
items.description: Slow-poached brook trout, brown butter, sorrel, and trout roe.

items.title: From the field
items.description: Pasture-raised lamb shoulder, juniper, roots glazed in lamb fat.

items.title: Sweet
items.description: Roasted plums, brown-butter financier, late-harvest Edelweiss.

data.heading: Reservations open four weeks ahead
data.subtitle: Tuesday through Saturday · 5:30 and 7:30 seatings. $95 menu, $145 with pairings.
